# Coverza

> Coverza is an online store in Pakistan selling iPhone and Samsung mobile covers (phone cases): clear, silicone, MagSafe, shockproof, leather, glitter and card-holder designs. All orders support Cash on Delivery nationwide, delivery in 2–4 working days, free delivery above Rs 2,000 and a 7-day free exchange.

## Key facts
- Country served: Pakistan only (all cities)
- Brands covered: Apple iPhone (iPhone 11 to iPhone 17 Pro Max, iPhone Air) and Samsung Galaxy (S25, S24, A and Z series)
- Price range: Rs 999 to Rs 2,799
- Payment: Cash on Delivery, JazzCash, Easypaisa, Visa/Mastercard
- Delivery: 2–4 working days; Rs 200 flat, free above Rs 2,000
- Returns: free exchange within 7 days for wrong model, damage or defects
- Ordering: website checkout or WhatsApp
